scope: One run, one machine, one SYNTHETIC 20-minute file (640x360, H.264 + AAC, test patterns and clicks). Shows the mechanisms hold at this length; not a performance qualification, not real footage or music. Export of the long timeline was not run.

checks.name: ingest: the 20-minute file is accepted and probed (duration within one frame of 1200 s, 36000 frames)
scene job: finishes and finds all 19 cuts on the exact frames, no false cuts
beat job: finishes with a tempo within 1 BPM of 120 and a beat count within 2% of 2400
edits made while both jobs ran all succeeded and stayed prompt (median under 100 ms, worst under 2 s)
split_at_scenes turns the 20-minute clip into 20 shots in one transaction; the timeline query answers within 2 s
editor: opens the 20-minute project and paints the very last frame (35999) after a jump to the end, picture not black, no page errors
